objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with fatigue, weight loss, and jaundice.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Doctor: What brings you in today? Patient: I've been dealing with persistent fatigue and my sleep quality is poor. Over the past month I’ve lost weight without trying, and I’ve noticed some jaundice.
Are you experiencing any abdominal pain, and if so, where is it located?

Patient: I don’t have any abdominal pain at all, and I haven’t noticed any specific area that hurts. I’m mainly just feeling very tired with poor sleep, along with the recent weight loss and jaundice.
Have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine or your stool, such as dark urine or pale, clay-colored stools?
Patient: My urine has seemed darker than usual, and my stools look lighter than normal—more pale than brown. I haven’t noticed any new abdominal pain, though.
Are you experiencing any itching all over your body, or have you had any fevers or chills recently?
Patient: I have had some itching across my body, but I haven’t had any fevers or chills. I just feel worn out and can’t seem to sleep well.
Do you have a history of smoking, alcohol use, or any previous medical conditions such as liver disease, gallstones, or inflammatory bowel disease?

Patient: Yes, I smoke about a pack of cigarettes a day and I drink around five alcoholic beverages daily. I don’t have any known past medical conditions like liver disease, gallstones, or inflammatory bowel disease.
Have you experienced any back pain, nausea,
Patient: I don’t have back pain, and I haven’t really had nausea. I mainly feel constantly tired, my sleep has been poor, and I’ve had the dark urine, pale stools, jaundice, and body-wide itching.
